STEP 1 READ DATA
=============================
```{r}
library(here)      # paths are built from the project root (CASA0005_Workspace.Rproj)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
d <- read_excel(here("TERR", "2018-SA1-dataset-individual-part-3a-total-NZ_updated_16-7-20.xlsx"), sheet = 8, skip = 9)
shape <- st_read(here("statsnz-territorial-authority-2018-generalised-SHP", "territorial-authority-2018-generalised.shp"))
summary(shape)
print("done")
```
STEP 2 CLEAN DATA AND EXTRACT GEOM
=============================
```{r}
shape %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  plot()
```
STEP 3 MERGE DATA
=============================
```{r}
shape2 <- shape%>%
  merge(.,
        d,
        by.x="TA2018_V1_", #shape
        by.y="Area_Code") #db
```
STEP 4 PLOT THEMATIC MAP (One column in a db)
=============================
```{r}
grep("Employed Full time", names(shape2), ignore.case=TRUE, value=TRUE)
#shape2 <- shape2 %>%
  #rename(paid_employee_2018 = `Employed Full time...17`) %>%   # use your actual name
  #mutate(paid_employee_2018 = as.numeric(paid_employee_2018))
library(tmap)
tm_shape(shape2) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "paid_employee_2018",
              fill.scale  = tm_scale_intervals(style = "quantile", n = 5),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Employed full time, 2018"))
hist(log(shape2$paid_employee_2018),
     breaks = 20,
     main = "Employed full time, 2018 (log scale)",
     xlab = "log(number of people)")
```
